Wondering if moments with strippers/hookers are acceptable? Asking for a friend (Anthony!).
On Fri, Dec 28, 2018 at 12:16 PM Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com> wrote:
Guys: I’m putting together a buzz package for New Year’s Day.
Can each of you send me your top three moments that happened on your beat this year?
All I need is a subhed/title with a 30-to-50 word explainer graf for each moment.
Let me know if this is an issue. Let’s set the deadline for these at 10 a.m. Sunday. But I’d take them earlier.
